item: Gas missingness differs from the page

item: GET index is not a consecutive test count
detail: Page: the GET index counts the tests of a person (its example is the third test). Ordering is consistent with age, so the lowest index is used as the first test.
145 tests are under 18 (youngest 10.8); page states 10 to 63. Excluded from the primary family, described separately, never shown at row level.
30 rows each, the same rows; not mentioned on the page; no overlap with gas missing tests (0). Not used in the primary analysis.
981 HR values missing and 53 values below 30 bpm (including 1 zero). Values below 30 bpm are set to missing in memory before peaks.
Files list ID_test before ID; page lists ID before ID_test. No effect.
Sex takes values [0, 1]; 1 is female per the page; consistent within person: True.
Time is increasing within every test; the largest gap between samples is 61 s. Zone time weights are capped at 10 s.
